decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The extent of the branch reduction shall be strictly limited to that which achieves a 2m clearance from the house and the remaining foliage, only. The works hereby approved shall be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: Works to a tree covered by ENFIELD ORDER NO. 2: (T1) Silver Birch ( Betula pendula ) - Prune lower lateral branches on the southern side of crown by up to 2m to achieve a 2m clearance between the house and the remaining foliage.
